title: The Boy Given Back to His Mother
themeTags: Jesus comes close when we cry
reflectionQuestion: Jesus saw one mother crying, and he didn't pass her by -- he came close and helped her. When you are sad, it helps to know that Jesus always sees you. What is something that comforts you when you feel like crying?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Widow of Nain, Luke 7:11-17). Mood=hurting (thin register). FEELING-FIRST: crying. Centered on JESUS' COMPASSION for one grieving mother, NOT the resurrection-miracle (Adam: 'the hug is the emotional climax, not the miracle'). Death stated once, gently. SHORT ONLY (Adam: its power is its simplicity). Indelible image: Jesus giving the boy back to his mother. Voice TBC (proposed VOICE_RUTH_COMFORT).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”
